scope: CPython execution of current Mission Lab recipes plus production JS orbital solver; not deployed authenticated UI validation

transit.time_system: BJD_TDB - 2454833 days; original FITS headers verified
transit.acceptance: absolute period difference < 0.005 d; depth in (0.005, 0.025); >= 1000 accepted cadences
transit.limits: One quarter; fixed 0.075-day box duration; no additional detrending or limb darkening fit; error is conditional on independent supplied flux errors. Grid spacing is not period uncertainty. No planet-validation significance inferred.

gaia.quality_cuts: finite positive parallax; finite parallax/error > 10; finite G and BP-RP; finite RUWE < 1.4
gaia.coordinates: ICRS degrees, Gaia DR3 reference epoch J2016.0; one-degree cone at (56.75,24.12)
gaia.acceptance: >= 50 accepted stars and absolute-G agrees with Astropy distance modulus within 1e-10 mag
gaia.limits: TOP 200 ordered by source_id, not a complete or cluster-membership-selected population. Inverse parallaxes. No extinction/zero-point correction, colour-excess cut or photometric error propagation. Error column is parallax-only.

orbit.acceptance: position < 1e-5 km and osculating period < 1e-6 s against same-epoch Horizons
orbit.limits: Tests conversion of osculating elements using the app Kepler solver, not future two-body propagation accuracy. Uses Horizons Earth+Moon GM, not the app Earth-only constant. Ephemeris uncertainties are not supplied; tolerances measure numerical agreement only.
